strings.meta.title: Otokrati – island conquest game for kids
strings.meta.description: A turn-based strategy game for kids aged 10–13: conquer a hand-drawn archipelago against a crab, a gull and an octopus, or against a friend. Free, in your browser, nothing to install.
strings.menu.seedTitle: The same code (seed) always gives the same map and the same dice rolls
strings.custom.title: Advanced rules
strings.custom.intro: Changed rules apply to every game until you change them back. Such games are just for fun: they earn no experience, stars or badges. The map code carries the rules too, so a friend with the same code gets the same game.

strings.help.title: How to play
strings.help.goal: Conquer the enemy capital, the tile with the crown. If neither falls after 40 rounds, whoever holds more tiles wins, and with equal tiles, whoever has more units.
strings.help.turn1: First place your reinforcements: you get 2 units plus one more for every 3 tiles you hold. A tile holds at most 12 units.
strings.help.turn2: Then send units. A tile with 2 or more units can send them to a neighbouring tile, and at least 1 always stays behind. Onto your own tile they move, someone else's they attack. A tile that receives units rests until your next turn. When there is nothing left to play, the turn ends by itself.
strings.help.fight: In every round both sides roll a die. The lower number loses a unit, and a tie goes to the defender. A defending capital adds 1 to its roll. The fight goes on until one side has no units left, and before you attack you see the exact odds.
strings.help.token: Awake token with eyes: the tile can still act.
strings.help.resting: Z z: the tile received units and sleeps until the next turn.
strings.help.tower: A tower defends with +1 on the die, whoever holds it.
strings.help.lighthouse: A lighthouse brings 1 extra reinforcement every turn.
strings.help.chest: A chest gives 3 pearls to whoever conquers it first.
strings.help.anchor: A sea lane joins the harbours: from one you sail straight to the other.
strings.help.pearls: You get a pearl for every tile you conquer. Pearls pay for tricks, one per turn. You unlock new tricks as your ship grows, and the list is in the logbook.
strings.help.perks: Conquering also earns you powers: after {list} tiles conquered you choose one of three. A power lasts until the end of the game, and your rival earns them by the same rule.
strings.help.duel: Two of you play on one device and take turns. The colour of the buttons shows whose fleet is next. In an adventure both fleets have the same tricks, the ones unlocked in the logbook. The first move of every new duel goes to the other fleet.
strings.help.controls: Pick a tile by tapping or clicking it. Tapping the target again confirms the order, so does Enter, and Esc cancels.
strings.help.custom: This game uses your own rules: {list}.
